lines.en: I limp forward.

lines.zh: 身上有些地方不太对了。
lines.en: Parts of me aren't quite right.
I drag my feet through the marsh.

lines.zh: 我拖着身子，往臭味最浓处走。
lines.en: Dragging myself, I head for the strongest stench.
It's dark here. I'm comfortable.
I go around a pool. The mud's too deep.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，身上都会响。
lines.en: Every step, something in me creaks.
I walk toward the smell.
My shadow is long. Ugly.

lines.zh: 我从黑森林这边走到那边。
lines.en: I cross the dark wood from side to side.
I stop and take two breaths.

lines.zh: 我这一身烂肉，也是一只数码兽。
lines.en: This rotting body is still a Digimon.
I stand. Any movement makes a sound.

lines.zh: 沼泽的雾，从脚边漫上来。
lines.en: Marsh fog rises around my feet.

lines.zh: 我伸了伸不太听话的手臂。
lines.en: I stretch an arm that doesn't quite obey.
I didn't use to look like this.
It's all right now too.
I wait for my master to speak.
When told, I go.
I'm not particular about food.

lines.zh: 这地方的味道很重，我不介意。
lines.en: The smell here is strong. I don't mind.
A sound. I tilt my head.
Something in me shifts.

lines.zh: 我泡在沼泽里，懒得动弹。
lines.en: I soak in the swamp, too idle to move.
Let it creak. I'm used to it.
I can't see very far.

lines.zh: 你看着我，我知道我难看。
lines.en: You're looking. I know I'm ugly.
No need to pretend otherwise.
You fear me. I don't care.
Do you carry a training whistle?
If so, I follow.
This patched hide takes hits well.
What's on me was scavenged.
Put together, it still works.
If you come closer, come slowly.
I'm not gentle in my movements.
I don't want to frighten you.
You don't flinch. You smiled.
Laughing will do. That's fine too.
I'm in front. I'll walk ahead.
You follow behind.
You're behind me. I'll take the brunt.
A piece of me fell off.
I crouch and pick it back up.
It presses back on.
That was a heavy blow.
My body sways, then steadies again.
I was never sturdy.

lines.zh: 被砸掉一块泥，我照样站着。
lines.en: A chunk of mud knocked off, and I still stand.
My legs still work. I can walk.
The wound's on my body. No rush.
A piece fell off. I haven't come apart.
I'll eat that.
I eat fast. Don't watch.
It doesn't taste very good.
It tastes poor. But I'm not fussy.
There's more on the ground.
Put it further off.
Set it further off. I'll come get it.

lines.zh: 我身上有味道，你忍一下。
lines.en: I smell. Bear with it.
I'll wash my hands after.
They don't come very clean.
Can't recall what for. Let it go.
After these, is there more.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，碰到一堆硬块。
lines.en: You hit me and met a pile of hard lumps.
I'm not steady. Two steps back.

lines.zh: 我的一条手臂挂住了你。
lines.en: One of my arms caught on you.
I work it loose slowly.
Don't touch the seams on me.
Don't touch the seams. They'd come apart.
Let's part. I'm slow.
Go ahead of me.
I'll wait until you're clear.
Wait till it's clear. Simpler that way.

lines.zh: 这身污泥，哪好意思靠近同类。
lines.en: Covered in sludge, how could I approach my own kind?

lines.zh: 我身上拼的东西，撑不了多久。
lines.en: What I'm put together from won't last.
So I don't think about it.
If you want to follow, follow.
If you follow, I won't drive you off.
In the marsh, we walk slowly.
You needn't fear how I look.

lines.zh: 我这副样子，也想要个伴。
lines.en: Even like this, I want company.
We'll be out before dark.
It's getting dark. Stay with me.
I bend. Something creaks.

lines.zh: 这块粪便，我捧起来看了看。
lines.en: I scoop up this dung and inspect it.
Tucked in a seam, this is usable.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进身上的缝里。
lines.en: I tuck it into a seam on my body.
Now it can't get away.
Too heavy. I'll shoulder it.
Yours. Here.
Let me look at what's on the ground.
Nothing good.
Put it down. I must still walk.
A sound up ahead.

lines.zh: 泥浆从我的缝里滴下来。
lines.en: Sludge drips from the gaps in my body.

lines.zh: 身上有东西在动，我压住。
lines.en: Something in me shifts. I hold it still.
Master, step back.
Standing in front. Don't pass.
I'm not quick, but I'm large.

lines.zh: 它要过去，得从我身上过。
lines.en: To get through, it goes through me.
It wants through. I spread my arms.
I've got something ready.
Something in my hand. I raise it.
Over my head. Throw it.
It struck home. Hit.
I stay turned that way.
It circles; I turn along with it.
This big, I can't turn fast.
But I know where it is.
I grip what's in my hand.

lines.zh: 它再走近一步，我就甩污泥。
lines.en: One more step and I fling my sludge.
I raise my hand to throw.
That one will land.
It dodged.
It dodged. Then I throw again.
Plenty on the ground. I have more.
I won't run out. Plenty.

lines.zh: 我把手里的东西扔过去。
lines.en: I throw what's in my hand.
It hits and sticks.
Not pretty, but it works.
I throw again.
I sweep an arm across.
The lumps on my arm are heavy.
It went off balance.
I step in while it's off.
I bear down with my weight.
It can't move. Neither can I.
I bear down. I'm heavy.
We'll hold like this.
I rise out of the marsh.
Mud and rotten leaves cling to me.
I'm bigger than I look.
This wood is dark. Good.
I drag myself in a circle.

lines.zh: 身上的东西碰在一起，响。
lines.en: Bits of me knock together.
There's a path through the wood.
My steps turn that way.
A smell. Something alive.

lines.zh: 我从黑森林的腐叶里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out from the black forest's rotting leaves.
This heavy, I walk slowly.
Slow, but I'll get there.
Fire touched me and I started smoking.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，散了一地。
lines.en: I rolled down the slope and scattered.

lines.zh: 泥水灌进来，我沉了一下。
lines.en: Muddy water poured in. I sank a little.
The blast took half of me apart.
Something went in and stuck.

lines.zh: 那光一照，我身上都松了。
lines.en: That light loosened everything on me.
Starving, I come apart faster.
Lightning struck and half of me went rigid.

lines.zh: 这里没有泥，也没有烂叶子。
lines.en: No mud here. No rotten leaves.
